verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a SaaS speech API like AssemblyAI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The existence of an OpenAPI spec and a versioned add-on domain value ("medical-v1") are adjacent signals, not a documented versioned-API or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
